alt: Interior of a restaurant bar with chandeliers, people seated at the bar, and a large orange decorative cross on the wall.

Modern bar with a black countertop, five bar stools with yellow seats, and a colorful floral mural on the back wall. Glassware and bar essentials are on the counter, and the bar features a mezzanine with bottles on display.
Interior of a modern, upscale restaurant with warm lighting, a large central tree, and a mix of seating options including tables with chairs and a bar area.

A small plate with three black bowls of different sauces, a large round bread, a glass of water, and a white plate on a white table in a restaurant with indoor trees and people dining in the background.
Decorative skeleton and doll figures dressed in colorful floral and patterned fabrics, with skeletal faces, set in an indoor environment.
Colorful mural of a skeleton playing guitar with flames coming from its mouth, set against a starry night sky, mountains, and cacti.
Inside a modern restaurant with wooden ceilings and stylish lighting, several tables are occupied by customers, and a bar area with staff serving drinks is visible in the background.
Close-up of a large quesadilla cut into sections, served with two cups of salsa and lemon wedges on the side.

A close-up of a pizza with cheese, meat, and herbs on a wooden table, with a glass of red wine, a water bottle, and a fork in the foreground. The background shows a bar counter and a person working behind it.
A slice of cheesecake with berry topping and a mint leaf on a white plate, a small cup of coffee, and a cocktail on a wooden table in a dimly lit setting with a decorative glass lamp.
Salad with peaches, cherries, prosciutto, mozzarella, and fresh mint leaves on a white plate.

A pizza with tomato slices, melted cheese, and basil leaves, a side salad with croutons and dressing, a plate of cooked pasta, and salt and pepper shakers on a wooden table at DeFALCO'S Italian Eatery and Grocery.
Empty upscale restaurant with round and rectangular tables, white and beige chairs, modern decor, large windows, and decorative lighting fixtures.
A grilled steak on a sizzling platter with a sprig of rosemary, with flames visible in the background and a glass of whiskey.
Interior of an upscale restaurant with tables covered in white tablecloths, a bar with chairs, a brick accent wall, and decorative jars filled with lemons and limes.
Grilled steak topped with a green herb and vegetable relish, garnished with fresh herbs, served on a black plate with drinks in the background.
Close-up of a crispy fried chicken sandwich with mayonnaise, lettuce, and pickles on a bun, with a knife inserted into the top bun.
Bar counter with a glass of whiskey on a napkin, colorful neon lights, liquor bottles on shelves, and a row of glasses.

Interior of a cozy bar or cafe with a wooden ceiling, dim warm lighting, a bartender preparing drinks, and a customer working behind the bar. There are multiple TV screens on the walls and various bottles and bar equipment visible.

A table with a large pizza topped with arugula, a bowl of strawberry salad with parmesan cheese, a slice of strawberry tart, a glass of lemon and ice drink, and a small glass of champagne with lemon slice.
A cheeseburger with lettuce, tomato, pickles, and melted cheese served with fries on the side.

A hamburger with lettuce, tomato, fried chicken, melted cheese, and a toasted bun, served with French fries on a white plate.
Interior of a cozy, nature-inspired lounge with wooden furniture, lush green plants, and ambient lighting, featuring a large wall art of a woman's face intertwined with tree branches.
Interior of a modern restaurant or bar with curved seating booths, a long bar counter with barstools, decorative lighting, and a large digital sign saying 'Riot House' in the background.
Crowd dancing and partying in a nightclub with pyrotechnics and modern lighting effects.
Outdoor view of a bar or restaurant with a sign that reads 'Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row' and American flags, featuring a modern rustic design with wood and metal elements.
A meal spread includes a sandwich, some steaks, fries, dipping sauces, a drink with a lemon twist, a bowl of cherries with mint, and a tray of sliders with condiments, all on a marble surface.
Shelves stocked with various bottles of alcohol, illuminated with pink and red lighting, with a television screen displaying a baseball game at the top.
Crowded bar or nightclub with neon signs, including Coors and neon American flag, and dim colorful lighting. People socializing, drinking, and taking photos.
People in a bar decorated with colorful string lights, ornaments, and tinsel for Christmas, with a large TV displaying a sports game.

Elegant bar with modern decor, large spherical pendant lights, a marble globe, and a sleek bar counter with various bottles. Seating includes chairs with black upholstery, some patterned, around wooden tables.
Person riding an electric bicycle on a paved path near a wooden fence.
A city skyline at sunset with high-rise buildings, a cloud-filled sky with orange and pink hues, and a mountain range in the background.

An art gallery with four large, colorful impressionist paintings on a brown wall. In front, there is a bronze sculpture of a barefoot woman holding a spear, standing on a round base, positioned on a wooden table. To the right, there is another bronze sculpture of a woman wearing a hat and skirt, holding a tray, also standing on a round base.
Nighttime outdoor stage with four dancers performing under purple and blue lights, neon light fixtures, and trees in the background.
